I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I thanked him and confirmed the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, replacing the number from this morning.

As he asked, I didn't do anything else. I didn't open #central-team or post the correction there. Seat counts are operational facts rather than finance figures, and he had already posted 84 in this channel himself, so repeating it here was fine.

I don't have a lasting record I can update. If someone asks about this later, I'll find the correction through his message in #central-random.
